sub_question: SQ-1: Published ILC vs IDC alpelisib response data post-CDK4/6i?

query_log.query: alpelisib invasive lobular carcinoma CDK4/6 inhibitor
query_log.note: Zero direct hits — no trial reports ILC-stratified alpelisib post-CDK4/6i data

query_log.query: PI3K inhibitor invasive lobular breast cancer histology
SOLAR-1 alpelisib histology subgroup breast cancer
query_log.note: SOLAR-1 histology subgroup not published in PubMed-indexed literature

query_log.query: CDH1 mutation PI3K inhibitor breast cancer response

gap_confirmation: GAP_CONFIRMED — No published clinical trial or retrospective study reports ILC vs IDC stratified alpelisib response in CDK4/6i-progressed patients. SOLAR-1 histology sub-analysis is not published.

supporting_evidence.citation: Chandran EA, Kennedy I. J Immunother Precis Oncol. 2020;3(3):133-136.
supporting_evidence.finding: Case report: 68-year-old woman with metastatic ER+ breast cancer harboring PIK3CA + NF1 + CDH1 mutations achieved SUSTAINED COMPLETE RESPONSE at 5 years to PI3K inhibition. CDH1 mutation co-occurred with PIK3CA — consistent with ILC-like molecular context. Authors attribute exceptional response primarily to NF1 mutation but CDH1 is co-documented.
supporting_evidence.strength: MODERATE — case report (n=1), CDH1 mutation noted but not attributed as driver of PI3Ki response. Histology not explicitly confirmed as ILC.
supporting_evidence.relevance: First clinical data point showing CDH1-mutant breast cancer can achieve exceptional PI3K inhibitor response. Consistent with the hypothesis's prediction.

supporting_evidence.citation: Elangovan A et al. Mol Cancer Res. 2022;20(9):1405-1419.
supporting_evidence.finding: CDH1/E-cadherin loss in ILC sensitizes cells to IGF1R activation and creates unique therapeutic vulnerabilities. E-cadherin functions as NEGATIVE REGULATOR of IGF1R — loss releases IGF1R → downstream PI3K/AKT amplification.
supporting_evidence.strength: STRONG mechanistic support — ILC-specific, peer-reviewed, in vitro + in vivo data
supporting_evidence.relevance: Orthogonal mechanistic pathway: CDH1 loss → IGF1R → PI3K/AKT is additive to the direct p85/p110alpha liberation mechanism (Bahreini 2017). Two independent CDH1-loss routes to PI3K hyperactivation in ILC.

supporting_evidence.finding: Cdh1 and Pik3ca mutations cooperate to induce immune-related ILC in mouse models. CDH1 + PIK3CA co-mutation produces authentic ILC phenotype — supports the CDH1-PI3Ka cooperation at the tumor initiation level.
supporting_evidence.strength: STRONG — mouse genetic model directly shows CDH1+PIK3CA cooperation in ILC genesis
supporting_evidence.relevance: Reinforces that CDH1 loss and PI3Ka activation are co-selected and functionally cooperative in ILC — not coincidental co-occurrence

evidential_quality.rationale: Two new supporting PMIDs: (1) PMID 35663259 — first clinical CDH1-mutant PI3Ki complete response case (+0.03); (2) PMID 35665642 — second independent CDH1-PI3K mechanism (IGF1R axis) in ILC (+0.02). Ceiling remains below 0.80 because ILC vs IDC comparative response data in CDK4/6i-progressed setting still absent.

plausibility.rationale: CDH1 loss now has TWO independent routes to PI3K hyperactivation (direct p85/p110alpha liberation + IGF1R → PI3K) and a clinical case of exceptional response. The ILC-specific vulnerability is mechanistically convergent.

supplementary_search.note: Second search pass found 3 additional real-world evidence papers not in original run

new_pmids.citation: Mouabbi JA et al. NPJ Breast Cancer. 2022;8(1):131
new_pmids.finding: MD Anderson real-world histology analysis, n=3784 HR+/HER2- mBC. Compares CDK4/6i, mTORi, and PI3Ki outcomes by histology (IDC vs ILC vs mixed). Largest published histology-stratified TT comparison. PI3Ki arm limited by early alpelisib adoption period but provides first real-world ILC vs IDC framework.

new_pmids.citation: Mazzoli G et al. (PALMARES-2). Breast. 2026 Apr;86:104692
new_pmids.finding: PALMARES-2 multicenter Italian real-world study: CDK4/6i effectiveness by histology (ILC vs IDC) in HR+/HER2- advanced BC. 2026 publication. CDK4/6i-focused (not post-CDK4/6i alpelisib), but demonstrates field is now producing histology-stratified targeted therapy comparisons.

new_pmids.citation: Kavazis C et al. Crit Rev Oncol Hematol. 2025;214:104805
new_pmids.finding: Systematic review: PIK3CA mutations in 30-50% of ILC (10 cohorts), higher than IDC. No significant prognostic impact of PIK3CA mutation in ILC studies. Limited data on alpelisib predictive value in ILC specifically.

updated_score.reason: Mouabbi 2022 (n=3784) + PALMARES-2 2026 confirm that histology-stratified TT analysis is clinically established. PIK3CA enrichment in ILC (30-50% vs IDC) via systematic review. These increase clinical relevance (ILC now established as having possibly inferior CDK4/6i benefit, per PALMARES-2 signal) and actionability (Mouabbi framework immediately extendable to PI3Ki arm).
